thread:
julia: Customer (henry@acme) reports repeated reauth prompts when switching between app.redwood.example and an embedded widget on partner.example. Started after yesterday's CDN/edge rollout. They see intermittent 401s on /api/session/validate and then get redirected to the login flow.
henry (Acme): Clearing cookies sometimes fixes it for a few minutes, but it comes back when they switch tabs or return from the iframe. Chrome on macOS.
deploy-bot: deploy: config-edge-proxy v3.2.1 rolled to prod @ 2026-03-16T22:04Z - changed Set-Cookie behavior to enforce SameSite adjustments and edge caching headers.
julia: Repro steps customer provided: 1) login at app.redwood.example 2) open partner.example page with our iframe 3) interact with widget 4) switch back to main tab -> forced reauth. Logs pasted below.
henry (Acme): ```
REQUEST /api/session/validate HTTP/1.1
Host: partner.example
Origin: https://partner.example
Cookie: session=; __csrf=...
RESPONSE 401 
Set-Cookie: session=; Expires=Thu, 01 Jan 1970 00:00:00 GMT
```
sam (eng-runtime): Sounds like cookies are being stripped or not sent from the partner iframe context. If cookie Domain is app.redwood.example it won't be sent to partner.example, but the iframe should still forward cookie to our edge if properly proxied. Did the edge change introduce header or cookie filtering?
alex (eng-security): Noted. v3.2.1 introduced an experimental 'edge-cookie-bypass' optimization to avoid forwarding cookies on CDN-cached nodes. There's a bug where requests with `Origin` + `x-rl-region` sometimes dropped the Cookie header.
maria (devex): Our SDK sets Set-Cookie with `SameSite=None; Secure` for cross-site use, but we also rolled a server-side safety change to `SameSite=Lax` for non-auth endpoints yesterday. Could be a mismatch between cookie attributes and edge behavior.
sam (eng-runtime): Quick local repro I ran (simulating partner host):
```
curl -v -H "Origin: https://partner.example" -H "Cookie: session=abc123" \
  https://edge.redwood.example/api/session/validate
```
On ~30% of requests the Cookie header was absent when it reached the backend on our edge nodes. Node selection correlated with `x-rl-region` header presence.
julia: Customer is blocked in production. They requested a mitigation ASAP. Options: rollback edge change or apply an immediate proxy patch to preserve Cookie when Origin present.
alex (eng-security): Mitigation options ranked: 1) rollback v3.2.1 (fastest) 2) hotfix in edge-proxy to stop dropping Cookie when `Origin` exists and auth route detected 3) backend forcing Domain=.redwood.example + SameSite=None (requires deploy). Rollback recommended for immediate relief.
sam (eng-runtime): I opened PR #3245 to revert the edge-cookie-bypass change and added a test to assert Cookie forwarding for cross-site iframe requests. Can roll back in ~30 minutes if approvals clear.
maria (devex): If we rollback, we'll send a customer-facing note and update the SDK docs to call out embedded iframe integration tips.
henry (Acme): Appreciate the quick response. I can run the curl test from our partner host and paste results. Let me know when rollback is live and I'll confirm.
julia: Thanks team — assigning to eng-runtime and eng-security for rollback + postmortem. I'll update the customer once rollback is confirmed. :thumbsup:
